contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN C[--]NTI[VS] PF AVG ; R/ FEL TEMP [REPARATIO]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Emperor left on galley, probably Trier mint issue of 348-350, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN C[--]NTI[VS] PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor on galley left with phoenix on outstretched hand and holding standard, Victory steering, A in left field.
